name: LI-OV2312-GMSL2-110H

sources.title: LI-OV2312-GMSL2-xxxH Data Sheet, revision 1.1, 7 Mar 2021 (Leopard Imaging)
sources.covers: sensor, optical format, resolution, pixel size, shutter, output, power supply range, lens (EFL, F/#, FOV H and V, filter), connector, size, mass, USB 3.0 kit frame rate

note: An RGB-IR global-shutter GMSL2 camera (OmniVision OV2312, 650 nm + 940 nm dual-band filter), for in-cabin monitoring in the maker's words; listed for wide RGB plus NIR views. The 110H lens: EFL 2.666 mm, F/2.4, FOV 110 degrees (H) x 87 degrees (V), M12. The FOV is taken to refer to the full 1600 x 1300 array (not said). The lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption: with 3.0 um pixels the stated EFL gives 889 px, for which a pinhole would show about 84 degrees across 1600 px, not the stated 110, so the lens has strong barrel distortion the maker does not state; calibrate a unit. The only frame rate stated is through Leopard's USB 3.0 kit (LI-USB30-OV2312-GMSL2-xxxH): 1600 x 1300 @ 30 fps, 10-bit RAW; the GMSL2 frame rate is not stated. power_w is null: only the supply range (9 to 19 V) is stated, and the USB kit's consumption is "TBD". size_mm is the stated 30 (L) x 30 (W) x 29.2 (D) mm, entered as [29.2, 30, 30] with D along the optical axis. The role is rgb (the sensor is RGB-IR). IPX9K.
